spanish: Y varón o mujer, cuando fueren en piel de su carne manchas, manchas blancas,

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3rd masculine singular is rendered as plural fueren, so the verb number no longer matches.
Both nouns are the bright-spot lexeme; manchas names a generic spot and may omit the brightness.

notes: cuando plus subjunctive is smoothing of כי plus imperfect; su can cover the 3mp suffix.
